nodes.name: Every Minute
nodes.notes: Runs the outbox dispatcher every minute after workflow activation. Manual execution is also supported.

nodes.name: Build Claim Request
nodes.notes: Creates one correlation ID and a bounded claim request. Batch size is read from SIS_NOTIFICATION_BATCH_SIZE.

nodes.name: Log Dispatcher Start
nodes.notes: Best-effort dispatcher run evidence. Logging failure does not block delivery.

nodes.name: Claim Notification Batch
nodes.notes: Claims a bounded batch with database row locks. Transport failures retry; stale uncertain sends are dead-lettered rather than duplicated.

nodes.name: Render Notification Batch
nodes.notes: Expands claimed rows and renders text-only messages from controlled template codes. Empty batches produce one control item.

nodes.name: Has Claimed Notification?
nodes.notes: True: process one claimed notification. False: finish an empty dispatcher run.

nodes.name: Begin Delivery Attempt
nodes.notes: Reserves the provider attempt before sending. Replayed begin calls return should_send=false and do not duplicate an external message.

nodes.name: Begin Attempt Decision
nodes.notes: Validates the begin-attempt response and restores the claimed notification context.

nodes.name: Should Send?
nodes.notes: False means this exact attempt already exists, so the provider call is skipped.

nodes.name: Is Email Channel?
nodes.notes: Gmail is the only active pilot delivery provider. Other channels are recorded as permanent configuration failures.

nodes.name: Send Gmail Message
nodes.notes: Sends one text email. Node-level retries are intentionally disabled because the database attempt reservation is the only retry owner.

nodes.name: Build Gmail Attempt Result
nodes.notes: Classifies the Gmail provider result as delivered, temporary failure or permanent failure. Error text is sanitized and truncated.

nodes.name: Build Unsupported Channel Result
nodes.notes: Records unsupported channels as permanent failures without attempting an external provider.

nodes.name: Record Delivery Attempt
nodes.notes: Idempotently finalizes the reserved attempt, applies bounded backoff or dead-letter state, and records provider evidence.

nodes.name: Log Dispatcher Completion
nodes.notes: Best-effort completion evidence after a delivery attempt is durably recorded.

nodes.name: Log Empty Dispatcher Run
nodes.notes: Closes the workflow-run record when the outbox is empty.

nodes.name: Log Deduplicated Attempt
nodes.notes: Closes a run where an idempotent begin-attempt replay correctly prevented a duplicate provider call.

nodes.name: Validate Delivery Record
nodes.notes: Stops the execution when the terminal delivery outcome was not durably recorded in Supabase.
